description: This Java source file defines an enumeration CommonMdcEntryKey used for representing MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entry keys, specifically for logging purposes within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes a predefined key for correlation ID and implements the CharSequence interface for flexibility.

classes.name: CommonMdcEntryKey
classes.description: An enumeration of commonly known MDC entry keys, implementing CharSequence interface, primarily providing a key for correlation ID used in logging contexts.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the key string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index in the key string.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the key string between start and end indices.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the key.
